title: Lesson 4: The Lightning Thief, Chapter 1

segments.text: Teacher reviews determining/clarifying the meaning of words and demonstrates how to use context.
Students will add this week's vocabulary words to their Unit Vocabulary graphic organizers.
Instead, think about using morphology when teaching the vocabulary words. Introduce morphology tied to myth language: mort-, -ology, trans-. If mort means death, what does immortal mean?
10 vocabulary words are taught, which is a lot for depth vocabulary words

homework: Read and annotate The Lightning Thief Ch. 1 (pp. 9–15)
